verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs describe Templates as saved, reusable page layouts that form the starting point for every new Object you create. Combined with custom Types, this covers applying a template when creating recurring kinds of notes. Nothing in the pack shows dynamic variables such as date or title being filled in, which is an explicit part of the story. Missing for 10: template variables/placeholders (date, title), any hands-on or independent corroboration of the template workflow.
